site.description: Notes from a developer's workbench: small discoveries, build logs and longer write-ups.
site.author: Ada Fieldwork
site.heroText: Small daily discoveries, build logs and longer project write-ups about the web, tooling and the systems underneath.
site.aboutHtml:
I build web software and the infrastructure it runs on. This site collects what I learn along the way, from a one-line shell trick to a month-long migration.

Every post is written to be useful a year from now: what I tried, what broke, what the numbers said and what I would do differently.

If something here saved you an afternoon, or you think I got it wrong, write to ada@bench.example.

export async function retry(fn, attempts = 4) {
  for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      const delay = 2 ** i * 100 + Math.random() * 100;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
    }
  }
  throw new Error('retry budget exhausted');
}
